overall_summary: Meta’s Q4 2024 earnings call showed strong ad revenue growth internationally but mixed cost pressures. While ad performance and family‑app expenses drove modest gains, flat marketing sales, currency headwinds, regulatory challenges, and rising infrastructure costs weighed on outlook. Sentiment was overwhelmingly neutral (76.1%), with a small positive tilt (22.7%) and minimal negative sentiment (1.2%).
